guidedInputs.description: Describe the regulatory change, paste relevant text, or provide the URL. What has been published, amended, or announced?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. EBA published final Guidelines on internal governance under AMLA (EBA/GL/2025/03) on 15 January 2025. The guidelines set requirements for the compliance function structure, MLRO responsibilities, and three-lines-of-defence design for obliged entities...

guidedInputs.label: Institution Type

guidedInputs.label: Current State (if known)
